grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and check your State Pension age eligibility

grants.description: Provide details from your partner's death certificate
grants.purpose: To verify your partner's death and calculate claim timing

grants.description: Check your partner's National Insurance contribution record
grants.purpose: To determine if your partner paid sufficient National Insurance contributions for you to be eligible

grants.description: Confirm your relationship to the deceased
grants.purpose: To verify your eligibility and determine your payment rate

grants.description: Check if you were receiving or entitled to Child Benefit
grants.purpose: To determine if you qualify for the higher payment rate

grants.description: Declare if you were pregnant when your partner died
grants.purpose: To determine if you qualify for the higher payment rate

grants.description: Provide bank account details for payment
grants.purpose: To pay your Bereavement Support Payment into your account

grants.description: Share information about benefits you currently receive
grants.purpose: To notify your benefits office and ensure correct ongoing entitlements

revocation.mechanism: Contact DWP Bereavement Service helpline or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before decision. If revoked after approval, payments will stop immediately.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide bank account details on your behalf without explicit confirmation. Agent cannot make declarations about pregnancy or relationship status without your direct input. Agent cannot appeal a decision on your behalf. Agent cannot change payment details after approval without your explicit authorization.
